title: Splendor in the Sand | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step into a world of refined elegance as you enter this beautifully appointed three-bedroom, three and a half-bath haven. With two king masters boasting newly renovated ensuite bathrooms, and two spacious living areas, this cottage offers the perfect blend of comfort and sophistication. The pristine chef's kitchen, complete with a Viking gas range, custom built-in refrigerator, ample storage, and a magnificent marble island with seating for seven, is a true culinary oasis. The seamless transition from the kitchen to the main living area, adorned with stunning beamed ceilings, a smart TV, designer sectional, and tasteful blinds and drapes, creates a harmonious space for relaxation and entertainment. Retreat to the generously sized master bedrooms, each featuring a king-size bed dressed in Peacock Alley linens. The spa-like ensuite bathrooms provide a sanctuary for rejuvenation, while the upstairs master also offers a full-size murphy bed and a convenient washer and dryer. The third bedroom is thoughtfully designed with a custom built-in queen bed and two bunk beds, accompanied by its own ensuite bathroom featuring a new bathtub and shower. For those who appreciate outdoor living, the inviting space just off the kitchen boasts a new gas grill and a high-top table with chairs, perfect for alfresco dining and gatherings.

Features: Indoor Gourmet kitchen TVMicrowave Internet Dryer
Misc Private residential beach access Wi
Parking information- Private driveway with parking for two.
